Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of MoSe2 and MoSe2/MXene were obtained to confirm the presence of MoSe2 on MXene. MoSe2 shows four diffraction peaks at 13.2, 31.8, 38.3, and 56.2° (Figure S1), which correspond to 2H-MoSe2 (JCPDS No. 29-0914). The characteristic peaks of MoSe2/Ti3C2Tx (green curve in Figure 1a) also agree well with 2H-MoSe2, and the peak (002) at 7.1° is ascribed to the presence of the underlying MXene structure, indicating the successful preparation of MoSe2/Ti3C2Tx.
